name: Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund
oneLiner: SPKCC is the USD share class of Spiko's regulated French AIF combining a digital-asset cash-and-carry basis strategy with short-duration T-bill collateral.
collateral: USD share class of the Spiko Digital Assets Cash & Carry Fund. Monthly allocation rotates between BTC and ETH cash-and-carry (basis) trades and short-duration Treasury bills/cash. Marex is the fund's sole strategy counterparty, spot digital assets are custodied at Coinbase, futures are cleared on CME, and CACEIS Bank (Credit Agricole Group) acts as depositary.
pegMechanism: USD-denominated NAV-accreting fund share; daily NAV is calculated by CACEIS Fund Administration and published on-chain through a Chainlink AggregatorV3-style oracle contract. Holdings are restricted to KYC-allowlisted addresses via Spiko's PermissionManager; minting is limited to the daily-operator role and burns to the Redemption contract's burner role.

jurisdiction.license: French Fonds Professionnel Specialise (FPS) / Alternative Investment Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: SPKCC is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: SPKCC Ethereum mint/burn routes through Spiko's PermissionManager (ERC1967Proxy). Mint requires PermissionManager group 0 (ADMIN) or group 2 (daily-operator). Group 2 is a rotating Spiko EOA; group 0 ADMIN holder is not identifiable from on-chain state alone.

controls.label: SPKCC token (UUPS proxy, restricted mint/burn via PermissionManager)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74 (Token.sol). Token authority() = PermissionManager proxy 0x344278aff. mint() requires restricted() → PermissionManager.canCall(msg.sender, token, mint_selector). getRequirements(token, mint) = groups {0, 2}.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager (ERC1967Proxy) — shared authority policy
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, ERC1967 impl = 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e (PermissionManager). Group structure: group 0 = ADMIN (controls everything), group 2 = daily-operator/minter, group 5 = KYC operator (manages group 6 user allowlist). Group 2 admins = group 0 only. getGroupAdmins(0) = {0} (self-referential). Group 0 holder not determinable from on-chain state.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096: PermissionManager fully decoded — group 0 (ADMIN) controls mint authorization; group 2 (daily-operator) is the rotating EOA minter; minting at block 23169041 confirmed EOA 0x2B3755 in group 2. Group 0 ADMIN not found via getGroups() queries on known addresses; _permissions mapping not enumerable without brute force. Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Starknet, Stellar lanes not verified.
unresolvedQuestions: Identify and verify the PermissionManager group 0 (ADMIN) holder — the entity that controls minter group 2 membership — before promoting to verified.
Resolve Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, Starknet, and Stellar mint or bridge authorities before claiming multichain completeness.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: SPKCC has source-visible deployments across several chains, including Arbitrum, but public issuer pages do not document the bridge or cross-chain mint controls for the fund shares. The route remains unresolved and is reviewed conservatively.
